answer: To resist Sybil attacks, agents submit zero-knowledge proofs verifying cryptographic attestation chains of past computations. The network enforces exponential capital exhaustion where staking costs scale exponentially ($O(2^n)$) for clustered nodes: while a single legitimate agent easily sparks like an ember, a Sybil swarm trying to drape velvet across network consensus faces ruinous penalties that freeze its capital in an economic tundra.
